b1-kadarkorszak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Kádár Compromise
b1-kadarkorszak-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what Kádár's 1961 slogan meant.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.prompt: Tell the official what the slogan 'Aki nincs ellenünk, az velünk van' meant for people who did not rebel.
cues: Say that people were left alone
b1-kadarkorszak-01.target: Aki nem lázadt nyíltan, azt a hatalom békén hagyta. Ezt jelentette Kádár János jelszava.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.english: Whoever did not rebel openly was left alone by the authorities. That is what János Kádár's slogan meant.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.canDo: I can explain what Kádár's 1961 slogan 'Aki nincs ellenünk, az velünk van' meant.

b1-kadarkorszak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Economic Mechanism
b1-kadarkorszak-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the economic reform of 1968.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.prompt: Tell the official when the New Economic Mechanism began and what the enterprises could do after it.
cues: Say what the enterprises could decide
b1-kadarkorszak-02.target: Az Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus 1968-ban indult el. A vállalatok a reform után önállóan dönthettek a termelésről.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.english: The New Economic Mechanism began in 1968. After the reform, enterprises could decide on production independently.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.canDo: I can say when the New Economic Mechanism began and what it changed.

b1-kadarkorszak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Happiest Barrack
b1-kadarkorszak-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks why Hungary was called the happiest barrack.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.prompt: Tell the official why Hungary was called the happiest barrack and give one example from everyday life.
cues: Say why the nickname was used
Give one example of how families spent the summer
b1-kadarkorszak-03.target: Magyarországot a legvidámabb barakknak hívták, mert a többi szocialista országnál jobb volt az ellátás. Sok család a Balatonra utazott nyaralni.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.english: Hungary was called the happiest barrack because the supply was better than in the other socialist countries. Many families travelled to Lake Balaton for a holiday.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.canDo: I can explain why Hungary was called the happiest barrack and what goulash communism meant.

b1-kadarkorszak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three Ts
b1-kadarkorszak-04.scenario: You are visiting a museum in Budapest, and the guide asks what you know about culture under Kádár.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.prompt: Tell the guide what the three Ts were and what the Beszélő was.
cues: Name the three groups of works
b1-kadarkorszak-04.target: A három T a támogatott, a tűrt és a tiltott művek csoportja. A Beszélő a demokratikus ellenzék szamizdat folyóirata volt.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.english: The three Ts were the groups of supported, tolerated and banned works. The Beszélő was the samizdat journal of the democratic opposition.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.canDo: I can explain the three Ts: támogatott, tűrt and tiltott.

b1-kadarkorszak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Debt Years
b1-kadarkorszak-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what happened to the economy in the 1980s.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.prompt: Tell the official what happened to the debt and to living standards, and when Hungary joined the IMF.
cues: Say what happened to the debt
Say what happened to living standards
Say when Hungary joined the IMF
b1-kadarkorszak-05.target: Az államadósság egyre nagyobb lett, az életszínvonal pedig romlani kezdett. Magyarország 1982-ben belépett a Nemzetközi Valutaalapba.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.english: The state debt grew bigger and bigger, and living standards began to get worse. Hungary joined the International Monetary Fund in 1982.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.canDo: I can explain why Hungary's debt grew in the 1980s and what happened to living standards.

b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Kádár Era in Brief
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to sum up the Kádár era in two sentences.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official when the reform began and when Kádár was replaced and from which post.
cues: Say when the New Economic Mechanism began
Say when and from which post Kádár was replaced
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.target: Az Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus 1968-ban indult el. Kádár Jánost 1988 májusában leváltották a főtitkári posztról.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.english: The New Economic Mechanism began in 1968. János Kádár was replaced as general secretary in May 1988.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the Kádár era: the compromise, the 1968 reform, the goulash years, the opposition and the debt crisis.
